question: Does decoy-aware targeting (a melee unit never spends its strike on a one-model decoy while it can strike a real stack) improve the default against the owner's checkerboard decoy fort, without costing more than 2 points against a ring decoy fort, the AI mirror or owner-shaped armies?
origin: Owner game 9a1003ec (2026-11-22, 'won with this cool strat'): a checkerboard wall of one-creature Fairy splits in front of a corner fort beat ai:v0.8:brutal; the owner asked to think about it measurably and to lock in wins. Development (300 tasks each, prod21c6): against the checkerboard fort +8.17 (95% +3.00 to +13.17), avoidable decoy strikes 8.8% -> 0.4% of AI melee strikes; ring fort +0.83 (-4.17 to +5.83); mirror +1.50 (-1.83 to +4.83).

candidate.rule: HOC_RESEARCH_DECOY_AWARE=entrant (prod21c6): common src/ai/decoy_research.ts; candidates.ts drops challengers that melee-strike a one-model decoy (a one-creature stack whose creature has a bigger living stack in its army) while another candidate strikes a real stack (candidate 0 stays); the adapter redirects a native decision that strikes a decoy to the best real-stack strike (most cumulative HP).
candidate.seams: HOC_RESEARCH_FIX_SEATS=both; HOC_RESEARCH_ENTRANT_SEARCH="{}"; deterministic work mode; runner life-run14.ts / life-pool14.sh
candidate.implementation: prod21c6 = prod21 (server dbb41ce + common 1715a218 + the v22 rejection fixes) + research seams, all inert without their switches; tree manifest 193209e7fa7ea8a7a02016ea48ce6440da7baa50283345ae1d9709a1b062fb13 (Mac = x3d).
candidate.control: the same tree and specs without HOC_RESEARCH_DECOY_AWARE

bank.namespace: decoy-aware-b-20261122-v1 (seeds16, allocate_v32.py: 2,016 tasks, audited against 984 ledgers, 0 intersections; seed-admission sha256 c1637a3964db676dfc7cda22fb46f6b8643e279dba55f46281299807e3296e85). The earlier decoy-aware-20261122-v1 scan (seeds15) was reserved and left unfunded (881 eligible draft roots < 900).
bank.drafts: h-drafts recipe (league-drafts4.ts, RUSH_VALUES=explore/table-a.json RUSH_PRIOR=0.5 RUSH_VAL_SLOTS=B1234 RUSH_T1=policy RUSH_T2=h1): entrant S:B1234:val vs native (both forts), S:B1234:val (mirror), S:B23:fast:K14 (owner)
bank.selection: round-robin across all 224 pool families: checker 600, ring 300 (subset of the checker tasks), mirror 400, owner 400

primary: paired difference candidate - control over all checker tasks, score points; 95% interval by bootstrap over pool families (fNNNN), 20,000 resamples, seed 20261122

gates.Y1: Strength: the lower bound of the checkerboard-fort 95% interval is above 0.
gates.Y2: Ring-fort guard: the difference is at least -2 points.
gates.Y3: Mirror guard: the difference is at least -2 points.
gates.Y4: Owner guard: the difference is at least -2 points.
gates.Y5: Quality: candidate games with a quality error at most the control's + 2.
gates.Y6: Second host: the 30 candidate tasks of bank/cfY-g5-checker.json and bank/cfY-g5-mirror.json rerun on x3d reproduce the digests.

analysis.dryRun: validated on development rows before registration (no bank row existed)

adoption: If Y1-Y6 pass, the rule is adopted into the default under the standing instruction and deployed to all servers (owner, 2026-11-22: 'always lock in wins please'); a failed gate stays recorded as failed.
